questions.stem_text:
Local caching of files is common in distributed file systems, but it has the disadvantage
that

options.A: Temporary inconsistencies among views of a file by different machines can result
options.B: The file system is likely to be corrupted when a computer crashes
options.C: A much higher amount of network traffic results

questions.answer_explanation: The correct answer highlights that local caching can lead to temporary inconsistencies because when multiple machines cache a file, they may not immediately reflect updates made by others, resulting in different views of the same file at the same time.
O(1) represents constant time complexity, meaning it does not grow with the size of the input, making it the smallest asymptotic notation compared to other complexities that increase with input size.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following language features requires that stack-based storage allocation be
used rather than static allocation?
questions.answer_explanation: Recursive procedures require stack-based storage allocation because each recursive call needs its own separate instance of local variables and return addresses, which the stack can dynamically manage as calls are made and unwound.

options.B: effective only if 3 or fewer processes are running alternately on the processor
options.D: faster to access than a direct-mapped cache

questions.answer_explanation: A 3-way set-associative cache allows each main memory word to be stored in any of three different cache locations within the same set, providing greater flexibility and efficiency in data retrieval compared to direct-mapped caches.

questions.stem_text: A device driver is assigned to a device when it connects to the Internet.
questions.answer_explanation: A device driver is not assigned when a device connects to the Internet; instead, it is a software component that allows the operating system to communicate with hardware devices and is typically installed prior to the device being used.

questions.stem_text: In Python 3, the function max([1,2,3,4]) returns the value 1 as it identifies the smallest element in the list.

questions.stem_text: Bitmap graphics can represent curves and angles, not all line segments are displayed as straight.
questions.answer_explanation: Bitmap graphics are composed of individual pixels, which can only approximate curves and angles, resulting in certain line segments appearing jagged or not entirely straight due to the grid-like arrangement of pixels.

questions.stem_text: In Python 3, the expression ['a', 'Chemistry', 0, 1][1] evaluates to 'Chemistry'.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is true because in Python, indexing starts at 0, so the element at index 1 of the list ['a', 'Chemistry', 0, 1] is indeed 'Chemistry'.
